pathways.compact_statement: The 2023 Tandubas workshop account links coastal livelihood/water pressures and inland movement with ancestral-site disputes; it is a low-confidence, source-stated local mechanism, not a measured climate effect on violence.
alternative_explanations: Pre-existing land rights, historical injustice, governance, livelihood change and settlement pressures independently shape conflict.
pathways.uncertainty: A 2023 workshop case, not representative or independently causal evidence. Local/Indigenous/vulnerable residents were not adequately represented; no current violence map or attribution of individual events to anthropogenic change.
recommendations: No structural linkage issue identified; review each cited passage for its specific causal link, alternatives and uncertainty before treating the pathway as verified.
